FIELDS.NAME: Maple Grove Inn
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Maple Grove Inn, we provide a welcoming and comfortable stay for our guests, featuring a collection of well-appointed guest rooms designed for relaxation. Our operations focus on delivering personalized service, ensuring that each guest feels at home. We offer complimentary continental breakfast daily, adhering to strict food safety protocols to guarantee quality and hygiene. Our property is equipped with modern fire protection systems, maintained in compliance with all local safety codes. We are dedicated to maintaining a clean and safe environment, implementing regular housekeeping and maintenance schedules. Additionally, our staff is well-trained in emergency procedures, with written evacuation plans in place to ensure the safety of all guests. Operating year-round, we do not engage in extended seasonal closures, allowing for consistent revenue and upkeep.
